{{Quote|Message to spacers in the Wroona system: Be advised that Imperial Customs forces are currently engaging a pirate fleet on the outer edges of the system. Spacers are advised to avoid the conflict, as Imperial vessels are engaging any non Imperial ships in the vicinity of the battle.|[[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]] [[METOSP/Legends|METOSP]]|<ref name="PSG" />}}
A '''battle''' took place in the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. Starships of the [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Office of Customs]] fought a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet in the outer edges of the system. Civilian vessels were advised by the [[Wroona/Legends|Wroonan]] [[METOSP/Legends|METOSP]] to avoid the area as Imperial forces were allowed to engage any non Imperial starships. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] was traveling in the Wroona system by the time of this conflict.<ref name="PSG" />
